07

Questions

Got questions? Here are answers.

Who or what is txtme.social?

A European social media app, built in Amsterdam. It starts where the others stop: in real life. You're only connected to people you've actually met. No algorithm, no ads, no data selling.

Does txtme.social have any algorithms?

No recommendation algorithm. Your feed shows what your connections share, in the order it happened. Twelve stories a day, then it ends. Nobody decides for you what you should see.

What is the txtme.social merch?

T-shirts, tank tops, cropped tops, plus caps and bags. Every piece carries a QR code that leads to your personal profile in the app. Someone you meet scans it, and you're connected. The shirt is the gateway, not the product.

How can I pay for my merch?

Through Mollie in Amsterdam: Wero, iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Bancomat Pay or direct bank transfer. You enter your payment details at Mollie, not with us. All prices include VAT.

Design values

The system behind txtme.social.

Every colour, size and movement in the preview comes from this sheet. Colours, type samples and buttons below are the live elements of the shop, not pictures of them.

01

Colour

Black carries the page. Cyan and pink are the brand and appear as a signal — in lines, numbers, buttons and headlines — never as decoration. Each page has one light section in bone.

Base

  • Ink#0B0B0CPage background
  • Surface#131315Image fields, tiles
  • Surface 2#1A1A1DSecond surface
  • Bone#EFECE6The light section on each page
  • Bone 2#E5E1D9Second light surface

Text

  • Bright#F4F2EEText on dark — off-white, never pure white
  • Muted#9D9B96Body copy, secondary information
  • Faint#66645FLabels, inactive states

Brand

  • Cyan#60C4E3Brand colour — signal and gradient
  • Pink#EB5986Brand colour — signal and gradient

Gradients

  • Brand#60C4E3 → #EB5986Lines, accents, active states
  • Soft#9FDCF0 → #CFD5FF → #F2A7BFHeadlines and main buttons on dark
  • Soft on bone#2A9CC2 → #6B6FD8 → #D9467AThe same gradient on the light section

02

Type

One typeface, Space Grotesk, in four weights: 400, 500, 600 and 700. Sizes grow smoothly with the screen between the two values shown. Body text stays below 64 characters per line.

03

Space

Generous and consistent. The same few measures repeat on every page, so the shop reads as one piece.

Page width
1480 px maximum, centred
Side margin
20 px on phones · 32 px from 640 px
Section spacing
96 px · 144 px from 640 px · 176 px from 1024 px (top and bottom)
Compact sections
64 px · 96 px from 640 px
Breakpoints
640 px · 1024 px · 1280 px
Touch targets
at least 44 × 44 px

4 : 5, the space is reserved before the image loads — nothing jumps

05

Motion

Calm and precise. Movement guides the eye; it never gets in the way of reading or scrolling.

One easing for the whole site
cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
What moves
only position and opacity — nothing that changes the layout
Scrolling
native, never taken over by the page
Reduced motion
if the device asks for it, animations are switched off
Benchmark
smooth on a phone with a six-times slower processor, not on the studio Mac

06

Principles

Fixed requirements of txtme.social that the design keeps throughout.

Typeface
Space Grotesk, one variable file, served from our own server — no third-party font service
Tracking
none — no analytics, no tracking pixels, no third-party requests

Privacy Policy - txtme.social

Updated: [] July 2026

Welcome to txtme.social.

This Privacy Policy explains how txtme.social collects, uses, stores, processes, protects, shares and deletes personal data when you use our Platform.

We have written this Privacy Policy in a simple and direct way so that you can clearly understand what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how we protect it, and what rights you have.

Please read this Privacy Policy together with our Terms of Service and our Community Guidelines and Content Policy.

01Who We Are

1.1. txtme.social is a European social media platform created to help people build authentic connections through real-life, offline interactions. Our goal is to provide a digital social media hub where users can connect, communicate, share memories, join communities, follow approved B2B channels, and use privacy-focused social networking features.

1.2. The txtme.social services may be operated by one or more of the following entities:

  • txtme.social B.V., which operates the native iOS and Android social media application
  • txtme.social apparel B.V., which may operate the website, homepage, future e-commerce shop, clothing brand, B2C products, and B2B clothing-related services
  • txtme.social marketing B.V., which may operate B2B client services, marketing services, B2B channels, and related products such as NFC table stands and other non-food marketing products

Together, these are referred to in this Privacy Policy as “txtme.social”, “we”, “us”, or “our”.

1.3. Our business is registered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

1.4. For privacy-related questions, you can contact us at:

Email:

Address:

02Services Covered by this Privacy Policy

2.1. This Privacy Policy applies to your use of all txtme.social services, including:

  • the txtme.social mobile application for iOS and Android
  • user profiles
  • QR-code-based connection features
  • location-based or offline connection features
  • the ‘Live Pulse’ feature
  • newsfeed and memory features
  • photos, videos, posts, comments, captions, and similar content features
  • direct messaging
  • communities, groups, and channels
  • B2B channels
  • creator and brand ambassador features
  • premium features and subscriptions
  • the txtme.social website or homepage
  • any future e-commerce shop operated under the txtme.social brand
  • any other products, services, software, features, or tools we make available

2.2. We refer to all of these together as the “Platform” or the “Services”.

03Our Privacy Commitments

3.1. txtme.social is built around privacy, safety, and user control. Based on the current design of the Platform:

  • We do not sell personal data.
  • We do not use targeted advertising.
  • We do not use behavioural advertising.
  • We do not use user data to train AI models.
  • We do not use recommendation algorithms for content ranking.
  • We do not use automated moderation tools to make enforcement decisions.
  • We do not intend to transfer personal data internationally.
  • We store personal data in Europe.
  • We may use anonymised or aggregated information for B2B analytics dashboards where users follow a B2B channel.
  • Payment data is handled by third-party payment providers and is not intended to be permanently stored by us.

3.2. If any of these commitments change in the future, we will update this Privacy Policy and, where required, inform users or request consent.

04Minimum Age

4.1. You must be at least 16 years old to create an account and use txtme.social.

4.2. We do not specifically target or appeal to children under 13.

4.3. If we become aware that a person below the minimum age has created an account or provided personal data, we may delete the account and related personal data, unless we are legally required or permitted to keep limited information.

4.4. If you are under 18, you should make sure that your parent or legal guardian is aware that you are using txtme.social, as authorisation for paid features, subscriptions, or purchases, additional confirmation or consent may be required where required by law, app store rules or payment provider rules.

05Personal Data We Collect

5.1. We collect different types of personal data depending on how you use the Platform.

5.2. When you create an account, we may collect:

  • full name
  • email address
  • username
  • phone number
  • verification information
  • login details
  • Apple or Google login information, if you choose to use social login

We use this information to create your account, verify your identity, provide access to the Platform, keep your account secure and communicate with you.

5.3. When you use txtme.social, you may choose to upload, create, send, post, display, or share content that may contain personal data, including:

  • profile photos
  • photos and videos
  • posts
  • captions
  • comments
  • replies
  • direct messages
  • stories
  • memories
  • community content
  • B2B channel interactions
  • other information you choose to provide

You remain responsible for the personal data you choose to include in your content that is voluntarily disclosed by you. You should not share personal data about other people unless you have permission or another valid legal basis to do so.

5.4. If you use direct messaging, we process information needed to send, receive, display, store, secure and manage your messages. This may include:

  • sender and recipient information
  • timestamps
  • delivery information
  • reports or safety-related information connected to direct messages

5.5. txtme.social is designed to support real-life connections. Depending on the features available, users may connect through:

  • scanning another user’s QR code from their profile
  • location-based connection features where users are in the same real-life location
  • phone-number-based discovery for premium users
  • other connection tools we may introduce

We may process information needed to enable these features, such as QR-code activity, connection status, limited location-related information, phone-number matching information, or discoverability settings. Our location-based features are designed to support real-life matching without collecting or displaying precise location data. Instead, txtme.social may use temporary token-based verification for location-based matching. This may include a temporary platform-generated token embedded in or connected to a QR code.

The token is designed to calculate distance or proximity between users, rather than to identify, display, or store a user’s specific location. We aim to process location-related data in a limited, privacy-protective, and proportionate way.

5.6. When you use the Platform, we may collect limited technical information, including:

  • device type
  • operating system
  • app version
  • browser type
  • session data
  • log data
  • crash reports
  • error reports
  • security-related information

We use this information to make the Platform work properly, adjust the Platform to your device, improve reliability, prevent misuse, and protect the security of the Platform.

5.7. If you use the txtme.social website, homepage, or future e-commerce shop, or if you purchase physical products, we may additionally collect:

  • shipping address
  • billing details
  • order details
  • delivery information
  • payment-related information
  • customer support communications

We use this information to process orders, arrange delivery, provide customer support, handle returns or refunds, prevent fraud, and comply with tax, accounting, consumer protection, or other legal obligations.

5.8. Payments for premium features, in-app purchases, subscriptions, webshop purchases, or other paid services may be processed by third-party providers, including app stores, payment processors, or other payment partners. We do not permanently store your full payment details. We may store limited transaction information, such as:

  • product or subscription purchased
  • amount paid
  • payment status
  • transaction date
  • order number
  • invoice or receipt information
  • refund or cancellation status

5.9. If you choose to follow a B2B channel, you may see posts, stories, brand content, community updates, or other approved content from that channel. When you follow a B2B channel, your interaction with that channel may be included in anonymised or aggregated analytics shown to the relevant B2B client. These analytics may include, for example:

  • age ranges
  • country-level information
  • general engagement statistics
  • follower numbers
  • channel interaction statistics

We do not provide B2B clients with your directly identifiable personal data for any purposes. If any analytics information could reasonably identify you, we will treat it as personal data and protect it under this Privacy Policy.

5.10. If you submit a report, appeal, reinstatement request, safety complaint, or other moderation-related communication, we may process:

  • the contents of your report
  • the reported content, account, message, profile, channel, or activity
  • your username or account information
  • the reported user’s account information
  • any supporting information you provide
  • internal review notes
  • enforcement actions taken
  • appeal or reinstatement outcomes

We use this information to review reports, enforce our Terms of Service and Community Guidelines and Content Policy, protect users, prevent misuse, and comply with legal obligations.

5.11. If you contact us for customer support purposes, we may process:

  • your name
  • email address
  • username
  • account details
  • message content
  • attachments or screenshots you provide
  • support history

We use this information to respond to your request, provide support, investigate issues, and improve our Services.

06Personal Data We Do Not Collect

6.1. We do not buy or collect personal data from data brokers or other third parties.

6.2. We do not collect personal data about users from public databases, marketing partners, data providers or other social media platforms for tracking, advertising or profiling purposes.

6.3. Apart from the personal data provided directly by you or generated by you when you use the Platform, in limited cases, we may also receive personal data about you from Apple or Google login services, payment providers, app stores, delivery providers, other users who interact with or report content on the Platform, B2B applicants or partners and competent authorities where legally permitted or required.

07Why We Use Personal Data

We use personal data for the following purposes:

7.1. To Provide the Platform: This includes creating accounts, enabling login, displaying profiles, allowing users to connect, supporting QR-code connections, providing direct messaging, showing posts, maintaining memories, operating communities, and enabling B2B channels.

7.2. To Improve Reliability and Security: This includes debugging, crash analysis, technical maintenance, security audits, abuse prevention, and service improvement.

7.3. To Verify and Secure Accounts: This includes account verification, phone or email confirmation, login protection, optional two-factor authentication, fraud prevention, and protection against unauthorised access.

7.4. To Enable User Connections and Discoverability: This includes QR-code connections, location-based or offline connection features, phone-number-based discovery for premium users, and related connection tools.

7.5. To Provide Direct Messaging: This includes sending, receiving, storing, displaying, and securing direct messages.

7.6. To Operate the Website, Webshop, and Physical Product Sales: This includes processing purchases, arranging delivery, handling returns, providing customer support, managing refunds, and keeping legally required transaction records.

7.7. To Process Payments and Subscriptions: This includes facilitating in-app purchases, premium features, subscription payments, payment confirmations, cancellations, refunds, and customer support.

7.8. To Provide B2B Channel Analytics: This includes showing B2B clients anonymised or aggregated insights about users who follow their channels.

7.9. To Maintain Safety and Enforce Platform Rules: This includes reviewing reports, removing prohibited content, issuing warnings, restricting features, suspending or banning accounts, protecting users, and preventing illegal or harmful conduct.

7.10. To Comply with Applicable Laws: This includes responding to valid legal requests, cooperating with competent authorities, preserving records where required, meeting tax and accounting obligations, and complying with applicable laws.

08Special Category Data

8.1. We do not intentionally ask you to provide special category data, such as information about your health, religion, political opinions, sexual orientation, biometric data, or similar sensitive information.

8.2. However, because txtme.social allows users to upload photos, posts, profile information, messages, and other content, your content may reveal sensitive information about you or others.

8.3. Where special category data is included in user-generated content, we process it only where necessary to provide the Platform, enforce our rules, protect users, comply with legal obligations or where another valid legal basis applies or where it is based on your explicit consent.

09Cookies, Tracking, and Session Data

9.1. The txtme.social mobile application does not use cookies. However, our website or webshop may use similar limited technical tools that are necessary to operate the website, maintain sessions, secure the service, process purchases or remember your choices.

9.2. If we introduce non-essential cookies or similar tools in the future, we will provide appropriate notice and ask for consent where required.

10Advertising, Marketing, and B2B Content

10.1. txtme.social does not display third-party targeted advertising.

10.2. We do not use behavioural monitoring or direct marketing based on hidden tracking.

10.3. If you choose to follow a B2B channel, you may see posts, stories, brand content or community updates from that B2B channel in your feed or other relevant areas of the Platform. This content is shown because you actively follow the B2B channel, not because we track you across services.

10.4. We may send you service-related communications, such as account verification messages, security notices, order updates, subscription updates, policy updates, or important Platform notices.

10.5. We will only send optional marketing communications if you have explicitly consented to it or where we have a valid legal basis to do so. You can opt out of optional marketing communications at any time.

11AI, Algorithms, and Automated Decision-Making

11.1. txtme.social does not currently use content recommendation algorithms for content ranking.

11.2. txtme.social does not currently use targeted advertising tools, behavioural monitoring, AI-generated content services, or user data to train AI models.

11.3. txtme.social does not currently use automated decision-making or moderation tools that produces legal effects, moderation or enforcement decisions concerning you or significantly affecting you.

11.4. If we introduce AI systems, recommendation systems, automated moderation tools, or automated decision-making in the future, we will update this Privacy Policy and provide additional information where required.

12Who We Share Personal Data With

12.1. We do not sell your personal data.

12.2. We may share limited personal data with trusted service providers who help us operate the Platform. These may include:

  • cloud hosting providers
  • payment processors
  • app store providers
  • Apple or Google login providers
  • delivery and shipping providers
  • customer support providers
  • security providers
  • analytics or technical service providers used for non-tracking operational purposes
  • auditors
  • professional advisers
  • legal, regulatory, or law enforcement authorities where legally permitted or required

12.3. These service providers may only process personal data for the purposes we allow and must protect it appropriately.

12.4. We do not share directly identifiable personal data with B2B clients for targeted advertising, behavioural monitoring, or individual user profiling.

13B2B Channels, Creators, and Brand Ambassadors

13.1. txtme.social may allow approved B2B channels, creators, brand ambassadors, and business users to use certain Platform features.

13.2. B2B users may need to apply and be approved before appearing on the Platform. We may carry out due diligence before approving B2B users.

13.3. B2B channels may receive anonymised or aggregated analytics relating to users who follow their channel.

13.4. B2B channels, creators, and brand ambassadors must not collect, copy, scrape, misuse, or identify users from Platform data or analytics.

13.5. If you intentionally tag, submit content to, or interact with an approved B2B channel, that B2B channel may be able to view or use that content depending on the feature, your permissions, and the applicable Terms of Service.

13.6. Any wider use of your content or personal data by a B2B channel must be based on your permission, a valid legal basis, and any applicable B2B or platform terms.

14Reporting, Safety and Law Enforcement

14.1. Users can report content or conduct through the in-app “Report” function.

14.2. Where we receive a report, we may review the reported content, account, message, profile, channel, or activity to determine whether it violates our Terms of Service, Community Guidelines and Content Policy, this Privacy Policy, or applicable law.

14.3. We may share information with police, courts, regulators, or other competent authorities only where we have a valid legal basis to do so. This may include situations where:

  • we are legally required to respond to a valid request
  • disclosure is necessary to protect users or others from serious harm
  • disclosure is necessary to investigate or prevent illegal conduct
  • disclosure is necessary to enforce our rights or comply with legal obligations

14.4. txtme.social exercises discretion in determining what data or information should be shared with law enforcement or other competent authorities. This may include, but not limited to, account information, phone number, email address, content or messages that are referred to in a complaint (subject to encryption limitations), transaction data, log data or location/proximity data.

14.5. Where legally allowed, we may notify affected users about requests for their data or actions taken on their accounts, unless doing so would interfere with an investigation, violate the law, or create a risk of harm.

15Where Personal Data Is Stored

15.1. We aim to store your personal data in Europe.

15.2. We do not transfer personal data internationally.

15.3. If we transfer personal data outside the European Economic Area in the future, we will only do so where appropriate legal safeguards are in place, such as an adequacy decision, Standard Contractual Clauses or another lawful transfer mechanism under data protection law.

16Security

16.1. We use technical and organisational measures to protect personal data.

16.2. These measures may include:

  • Signal Protocol (end-to-end encryption) for messaging features
  • SSL/TLS encryption
  • secure authentication
  • optional two-factor authentication
  • access controls
  • confidentiality measures
  • regular third-party security audits
  • monitoring for misuse or suspicious activity
  • separation of app and webshop address data, where appropriate
  • security review of service providers, where appropriate

16.3. You are responsible for keeping your login details, verification codes, QR code and account credentials secure.

16.4. If you believe your account and/or your personal data has been accessed without permission, you should contact us immediately.

17How Long Do We Keep Personal Data

17.1. We keep personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described under Section 7 of this Privacy Policy.

17.2. In general:

  • account data is kept while your account is active
  • content not saved under “memories” may be deleted after 45 days
  • content saved under “memories” may be kept while your account remains active, unless you delete it earlier
  • webshop order records may be kept as long as required for tax, accounting, consumer protection or legal obligations
  • payment transaction records may be kept where needed for accounting, dispute resolution, fraud prevention or legal compliance
  • reports, moderation records, and enforcement records may be kept where needed to protect users, enforce our rules, investigate misconduct or comply with law
  • security logs may be kept for a limited period to protect the Platform

17.3. When a user account is deleted or suspended, we will delete your personal data from our active systems, unless we are legally required or permitted to keep limited information for legal, accounting, tax, safety, security, dispute resolution, fraud prevention or enforcement purposes.

17.4. When a user account is deleted or suspended, txtme.social reserves the right to retain certain categories of personal data that are not strictly required by law, such as security and fraud prevention logs, moderation and enforcement records, safety complaints, pseudonymised analytics or records needed to prevent repeat abuse. These categories of data may be stored in anonymised or aggregated manner.

18Your Privacy Rights

18.1. Depending on where you live and the laws that apply, you may have the right to:

  • Right of access: you may ask us to confirm whether we process your personal data and request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
  • Right to information: you may ask us for information about how we process your personal data, including the categories of data processed, purposes of processing, legal bases, retention periods, sources of data and recipients of data.
  • Right to rectification: you may ask us to correct inaccurate, outdated, or incomplete personal data.
  • Right to erasure: you may ask us to delete your personal data where there is no longer a valid reason for us to keep it.
  • Right to restriction of processing: you may ask us to temporarily limit how we use your personal data in certain circumstances, for example, while we verify whether the data is accurate or whether we have a valid reason to continue processing it.
  • Right to data portability: where legally applicable, you may ask us to provide certain personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format, or to transmit it to another service provider where technically feasible.
  • Right to object: you may object to certain processing based on legitimate interests, including processing for direct marketing, where applicable.
  • Right to withdraw consent: where we rely on your consent to process personal data, you may withdraw that consent at any time. Withdrawal of consent does not affect processing that took place before consent was withdrawn.
  • Right not to be subject to certain automated decisions: where applicable, you may have the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing that produces legal effects concerning you or significantly affects you.
  • Right to complain: you may lodge a complaint with a competent data protection authority.

18.2. These rights may be subject to legal conditions, exceptions, and limitations.

18.3. You can exercise your rights by contacting our Privacy Team at []

18.4. Your request should clearly explain which right you want to exercise and provide enough information for us to identify your account and understand your request.

18.5. We will review your request fairly and respond within the timeframe required by applicable data protection law. Where the GDPR applies, we will usually respond within one month of receiving your request. If your request is complex or if we receive multiple requests from you, we may extend this period where permitted by law. If we need more time, we will inform you.

18.6. If we accept your request, we will take reasonable steps to give effect to it. This may include providing access to your data, correcting inaccurate information, deleting data, restricting processing, exporting data, stopping certain processing, or updating our systems.

18.7. In some cases, we may not be able to fully comply with your request. This may happen where we need to retain or process certain information for legal compliance, tax and accounting obligations, fraud prevention, safety, security, dispute resolution, enforcement of our Terms of Service or Community Guidelines and Content Policy, protection of other users, or the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

18.8. Exercising your privacy rights may affect your ability to use certain features or services of the Platform. For example, if you ask us to delete account data that is necessary to operate your account, you may no longer be able to use the Platform or certain features.

18.9. If your request relates to personal data processed by a third-party provider, such as an app store, payment provider, delivery provider, Apple, Google, or another external service, we may direct you to that provider where they are responsible for handling the request. Where we are responsible for the data, we will handle the request ourselves.

18.10. If you believe that we have not handled your request properly, you may contact us again so that we can review the issue. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection authority, including the Dutch Data Protection Authority, where applicable.

19Contacting the Data Protection Authority

19.1. If you are located in the Netherlands or your complaint relates to our Dutch establishment, you may contact the Dutch Data Protection Authority:

Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens

Website: https://www.autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl/en

19.2. You may also have the right to complain to the data protection authority in the EU or EEA country where you live, work, or believe your rights have been infringed.

20Changes to this Privacy Policy

20.1. We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in the Platform, our services, our data practices, legal requirements, safety practices, or business operations.

20.2. We will alert you about changes by updating the “Updated” date of this Privacy Policy.

20.3. Where appropriate or legally required, we may also notify you through the Platform, by email, or by another appropriate method.

20.4. Continued use of the Platform after changes become effective means that you acknowledge the updated Privacy Policy.

Vulnerability Disclosure Policy

If you find a security vulnerability, you should be able to tell us without friction. This page says how, and what we commit to in return.

01

Vulnerability Disclosure Philosophy

txtme.social B.V. believes effective disclosure of security vulnerabilities requires mutual trust, respect, transparency and common good between txtme.social B.V. and Security Researchers. Together, our vigilant expertise promotes the continued security and privacy of txtme.social B.V. customers, products, and services.

Scope

This policy applies to any digital assets owned, operated, or maintained by txtme.social B.V., including public facing websites.

02

Security Researchers

txtme.social B.V. accepts vulnerability reports from all sources such as independent security researchers, industry partners, vendors, customers and consultants.

txtme.social B.V. defines a security vulnerability as an unintended weakness or exposure that could be used to compromise the integrity, availability or confidentiality of our products and services.

Our Commitment to Researchers

  • We maintain trust and confidentiality in our professional exchanges with security researchers.
  • We treat all researchers with respect and recognize your contribution for keeping our customers safe and secure.
  • We will work with you to validate and remediate reported vulnerabilities in accordance with our commitment to security and privacy.
  • We investigate and remediate issues in a manner consistent with protecting the safety and security of those potentially affected by a reported vulnerability.

What We Ask of Researchers

  • We request that you communicate about potential vulnerabilities in a responsible manner, providing sufficient time and information for our team to validate and address potential issues.
  • We request that researchers make every effort to avoid privacy violations, degradation of user experience, disruption to production systems, and destruction of data during security testing.
  • We request that researchers provide the technical details and background necessary for our team to identify and validate reported issues, by e-mail to the address below.
  • We request that researchers act for the common good, protecting user privacy and security by refraining from publicly disclosing unverified vulnerabilities until our team has had time to validate and address reported issues.

Found something? Tell us.Found something? Tell us.

03

Vulnerability Reporting

txtme.social B.V. recommends that security researchers share the details of any suspected vulnerabilities across any asset owned, controlled, or operated by txtme.social B.V. (or that would reasonably impact the security of txtme.social B.V. and our users) using the e-mail address below.

The txtme.social B.V. Security team will acknowledge receipt of each vulnerability report, conduct a thorough investigation, and then take appropriate action for resolution.

Use the following e-mail address to submit your vulnerability report: dev@txtme.social. Please provide as much technical detail as possible to help our team validate and address the issue.

Welcome to txtme.social.

These Terms of Service (“Terms”) explain the rules and conditions for using txtme.social, including our mobile application, website, e-commerce shop, B2B channels, premium features, creator features, ambassador features, and any related service we provide.

We have ensured that these Terms are presented in a simple and direct way so that you clearly and comprehensively understand your rights, responsibilities, and the rules that apply when you use txtme.social. Please note that these Terms are a legally binding agreement made between you, whether personally or on behalf of an entity, and txtme.social. We encourage you to read these Terms in full and also our Privacy Policy and Community Guidelines and Content Policy.

You agree that by accessing our services, you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by all of these Terms. If so, txtme.social grants you a non-assignable, non-exclusive, revocable and non-sublicensable licence to use the services in accordance with these Terms and our policies. If you do not agree with all of these Terms, we advise you to discontinue use of our Services.

01Who We Are

1.1. txtme.social is a European social media platform created to help people build authentic connections through real-life, offline interactions. Our goal is to provide a digital social media hub where users can connect, communicate, share memories, join communities, follow approved B2B channels, and use privacy-focused social networking features.

1.2. The txtme.social services may be operated by one or more of the following entities:

  • txtme.social B.V., which operates the native iOS and Android social media application
  • txtme.social apparel B.V., which may operate the website, homepage, future e-commerce shop, clothing brand, B2C products, and B2B clothing-related services
  • txtme.social marketing B.V., which may operate B2B client services, marketing services, B2B channels, and related products such as NFC table stands and other non-food marketing products

Together, these are referred to in these Terms as “txtme.social”, “we”, “us”, or “our”.

1.3. Our business is registered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

02Services Covered by these Terms

These Terms apply to your use of all txtme.social services, including:

  • The txtme.social mobile application for iOS and Android
  • User profiles
  • QR-code-based connection features
  • Location-based or offline connection features
  • The “Live Pulse” feature
  • Newsfeed and memory features
  • Photos, videos, posts, comments, captions, and similar content features
  • Direct messaging
  • Communities, groups, and channels
  • B2B channels
  • Creator and brand ambassador features
  • Premium features and subscriptions
  • The txtme.social website or homepage
  • Any future e-commerce shop operated under the txtme.social brand
  • Any other products, services, software, features, or tools we make available

We refer to all of these together as the “Platform” or the “Services”.

03Other Policies that Apply

These Terms should be read together with our:

  • Privacy Policy
  • Community Guidelines and Content Policy
  • Any payment, subscription, e-commerce, B2B, creator, ambassador, or partner terms that apply to specific services

These policies form part of your agreement with us.

04Eligibility and Minimum Age

4.1. You must be at least 16 years old to create an account and use txtme.social.

4.2. By using txtme.social, you confirm that:

  • You are at least 16 years old
  • You have the legal ability to agree to these Terms
  • The information you provide to us is accurate and up to date
  • You will use the Platform in accordance with these Terms and our Community Guidelines and Content Policy

4.3. If you are under 18, you should make sure that your parent or legal guardian is aware that you are using txtme.social. For paid features, subscriptions, or purchases, we may require additional confirmation, consent, or payment authorisation where required by law or by the app store or payment provider.

05Creating an Account

5.1. To use txtme.social, you must create an account.

5.2. When you create an account, we may ask you to provide information such as:

  • Full name
  • Email address
  • Username
  • Phone number
  • Verification information
  • Login details

5.3. You may also be able to create or access your account through Apple or Google login.

5.4. You agree to provide accurate, complete and up-to-date information. You must not create an account using false information, someone else’s identity or details that you are not authorised to use.

5.5. You are responsible for keeping your account secure. You should not share your password, login details, verification codes, account access, QR code, or account credentials with anyone else. If you believe that someone has accessed your account without permission, you should contact us immediately.

06User Profiles, Searchability, Discoverability and Connections

6.1. User accounts are not intended to be publicly searchable and discoverable in the same way as many traditional social media platforms. Depending on the features available, users may connect through:

  • Scanning another user’s QR code from their profile
  • Location-based connection features where users are in the same real-life location
  • The “Live Pulse” feature
  • Phone-number-based discovery for premium users
  • Other connection tools we may introduce

6.2. Users cannot generally search for, discover or explore other users unless:

  • They are already connected with that user
  • The user has shared an invite or signal with them
  • The user is discoverable through the relevant location-based feature
  • Another platform feature expressly allows the connection or discovery

6.3. Users may be able to disable their visibility on maps or location-based views accessed by other users, depending on the privacy and visibility settings available in the Platform.

6.4. Our location-based features are designed to support real-life matching without collecting or displaying precise location data. Instead, txtme.social may use temporary token-based verification for location-based matching. This may include a temporary platform-generated token embedded in or connected to a QR code. The token is designed to calculate distance or proximity between users, rather than to identify or store a user’s specific location.

6.5. Event search through Live Pulse may work differently depending on the type of event. Search results for events hosted by approved B2B users are not limited by geolocation, and users can search for B2B-hosted events in other locations.

6.6. Events hosted by end-users are not searchable by other end-users with whom they are not connected. User-hosted events cannot be shared with or discovered by users who are not connected to the hosting user.

6.7. You are responsible for deciding who you connect with, who you invite, who you send signals to, and what information you share with them.

6.8. QR codes, Live Pulse, location-based features, phone-number discovery, invites, signals, maps or other connection tools offered by our Platform must be used in accordance with these Terms, our Privacy Policy and our Community Guidelines and Content Policy.

07Free and Premium Features

7.1. The basic version of txtme.social may be available for free, but some features may be limited.

7.2. Premium features may include, for example:

  • Additional direct messaging functionality
  • Phone-number based discovery or connection features
  • More profile photos
  • Additional profile, connection, or memory features
  • Other features we may introduce

7.3. Premium features may be provided through subscriptions, one-time purchases, in-app purchases, or other paid models.

7.4. The exact features, prices, renewal terms, cancellation rights, and payment conditions will be shown before you purchase or subscribe. These terms and conditions may be subject to change or update from our end.

08Payments, Subscriptions, and In-app Purchases

8.2. We do not intend to permanently store your full payment card details. Payment information may be handled by the relevant payment provider.

8.3. If you purchase a subscription or paid feature through Apple, Google, or another third-party platform, your purchase may also be subject to that third party’s terms, refund rules, cancellation process, and payment policies.

8.4. You are responsible for managing, renewing or cancelling your subscriptions through the relevant app store or payment provider where applicable.

8.5. Unless otherwise required by law or stated at the time of purchase, fees already paid may be non-refundable once the paid service has started or been made available to you.

10.2. B2B users must apply to txtme.social and be approved before appearing on the Platform or operating a B2B channel. About us

This isn't what social media was meant to be.So we built it again.

A social network you can put down. Built only from people you've actually met.

01How it works02Concept03Legal notice

Why we exist

We built the thing we couldn't find.

A network where the feed has an end. Where your photos have a number. Where nobody sells your attention while you look.

We're not against phones. We use them. We're against what they were turned into. And we know we're part of the same system. That's why it had to be built, not just said.

txtme.social — Amsterdam

01

Our story

It started when the world opened again.

Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam52.36° N · 4.88° E

  1. 01/ 03

    The pause

    After the lockdowns, most of our friendships lived on a screen. Then the doors opened. The apps didn't let go. We went back out and kept scrolling, right past the people in front of us.

  2. 02/ 03

    The question

    txtme.social began in Amsterdam with one question: what if a social network started where the others stop? Offline.

  3. 03/ 03

    The answer

    Not another app to fill the gap. A place that holds on to what happens when you close it.

“

We didn't wait for someone else to build it. Nobody was going to.

MB

Founded by

Marouan Boughattas

Founder & CEO · Amsterdam, the Netherlands

Re-define social media.Re-define social media.

02

What we hold on to

Bring real life back —and the peoplewho belong in it.

  1. Offline first. Every connection starts with a meeting. Not with a search, not with a suggestion.
  2. Real over fake. No followers to perform for. No numbers to chase. The people you see are people you've met.
  3. Your data stays yours. Private by default. No selling, no tracking, no surveillance.
  4. Nothing pulls at you. No algorithm, no ads. Nothing in the app is built to keep you in it.
  5. Independent and European. Independently run from Amsterdam. European servers, European rules.

03

How it works

Four steps. No search.

Every connection starts offline. There is no search. No usernames to find, no suggestions of people you might know. You connect one way: someone you meet scans your code. Everyone has one. It's on your phone, and on the back of every piece in this shop. The shirt is the gateway: you link the code once after it arrives, and from then on it points to you.

  1. 01

    Wear it.

    Your code is printed on the back. Small enough, big enough.Your code is printed on the back. Small enough, big enough.

  2. 02

    Meet someone.

    A show, a kitchen, a platform. Offline, the old way.A show, a kitchen, a platform. Offline, the old way.

  3. 03

    Scan.

    Your code, their phone. Or the other way round. Two seconds.Your code, their phone. Or the other way round. Two seconds.

  4. 04

    Connected.

    You see each other now. Nobody else sees either of you.You see each other now. Nobody else sees either of you.

  5. Get your code

Nobody here found you. Somebody met you.Nobody here found you. Somebody met you.

04

Concept

Social media, with the parts that hurt taken out.

Twelve screens from the app. And what's behind each one.

01 / 12

A feed that ends

Twelve stories a day, then it's over. Posts disappear after 45 days; what should stay goes into your memory vault. Strangers' profiles stay invisible, even when friends share their content.

Live pulse

What's happening near you, right now. Share where you are and friends come find you. Only the ones you know.

A map of real places

Verified cafés, bars and shows that joined the network. Nobody can buy a better spot.

A profile with twelve photos

No highlight reel, no counter. Twelve pictures, what you're into, what you're planning. Nobody you haven't met sees your profile.

What you're about

What you're into and what you're up to next. Visible only to the people you've met.

Messages that stay yours

Private by default, encrypted by design, screenshot-protected. No AI reads along. Notifications are off until you turn them on.

Direct messages

Only with people whose code you've scanned. No requests from strangers.

Group chats with an expiry

For the concert, the trip, the weekend. Nobody gets added unasked. When it's over, the chat is over.

Real conversations

No AI in between. Just the two of you.

Communities

People into the same thing. Join, show up.

Channels

Follow brands and makers without an algorithm deciding what you see.

Calendar

Your plans and events nearby, at a glance.

A feed that ends

05

The difference

What's the difference?

Instagram

08
  • Addictive algorithm
  • Big Tech owned
  • Keeps you scrolling
  • No encryption
  • Ads, Ads, Ads
  • Recommended posts
  • Location tracking
  • Data surveillance

txtme.social

12
  • No algorithm
  • Independent platform
  • No infinite scroll
  • Encrypted messages
  • No ads
  • Discover the offline world, friends, and yourself
  • No tracking
  • No surveillance
  • Offline user journey
  • Screenshot protected
  • Notifications disabled until you turn them on
  • No AI features
06

Where it's going

Small company. Big mission.

Bring people together where they actually are. At home, in your city, and everywhere you travel.

  1. 01

    In your city

    Cafés, bars and venues that share the same values join the network. People nearby find them because they're real. Not because they paid.

  2. 02

    On the road

    Trips, holidays, the girls' trip, the boys' trip. The people you meet along the way don't vanish with the flight home. One scan, and they stay.

  3. 03

    Beyond Europe

    Drafted in Amsterdam, started in the Netherlands, launched in Europe. Built from day one for the rest of the world.

Money is temporary. Memories are forever.Money is temporary. Memories are forever.

07

Our promise

You are not the product. You never should have been.

No ads. No algorithm. Your data is never for sale. These aren't features. They're the reason this exists.

It was never about merch.

Friendships, relationships, community: these are moments that happen offline. txtme.social is only the digital shell that keeps them. We need people who put the phone down, stay in the moment, and connect afterwards. The shirt is where it starts.

All questions
What is the txtme.social app?

The digital home for connections that started offline. A profile with twelve photos, messages, group chats with an expiry, a map of real places and Live Pulse. For iOS and Android. Launch is announced.

What is the txtme.social merch?

T-shirts, tank tops, cropped tops, plus caps and bags. Every piece carries a QR code that leads to your personal profile in the app. Someone you meet scans it, and you're connected. The shirt is the gateway, not the product.

Which countries are included in shipping?

Across Europe and internationally through our shipping partner. Every parcel ships insured, and shipping is included in the price. The exact country list and delivery times go on the shipping page as soon as they're fixed.

How can I pay for my merch?

Through Mollie in Amsterdam: Wero, iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Bancomat Pay or direct bank transfer. You enter your payment details at Mollie, not with us. All prices include VAT.

Questions? Answers.

All questions
What is the txtme.social app?

The digital home for connections that started offline. A profile with twelve photos, messages, group chats with an expiry, a map of real places and Live Pulse. For iOS and Android. Launch is announced.

What is the txtme.social merch?

T-shirts, tank tops, cropped tops, plus caps and bags. Every piece carries a QR code that leads to your personal profile in the app. Someone you meet scans it, and you're connected. The shirt is the gateway, not the product.

Which countries are included in shipping?

Across Europe and internationally through our shipping partner. Every parcel ships insured, and shipping is included in the price. The exact country list and delivery times go on the shipping page as soon as they're fixed.

How can I pay for my merch?

Through Mollie in Amsterdam: Wero, iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Bancomat Pay or direct bank transfer. You enter your payment details at Mollie, not with us. All prices include VAT.

All questions
What is the txtme.social app?

The digital home for connections that started offline. A profile with twelve photos, messages, group chats with an expiry, a map of real places and Live Pulse. For iOS and Android. Launch is announced.

What is the txtme.social merch?

T-shirts, tank tops, cropped tops, plus caps and bags. Every piece carries a QR code that leads to your personal profile in the app. Someone you meet scans it, and you're connected. The shirt is the gateway, not the product.

Which countries are included in shipping?

Across Europe and internationally through our shipping partner. Every parcel ships insured, and shipping is included in the price. The exact country list and delivery times go on the shipping page as soon as they're fixed.

How can I pay for my merch?

Through Mollie in Amsterdam: Wero, iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Bancomat Pay or direct bank transfer. You enter your payment details at Mollie, not with us. All prices include VAT.

Questions? Answers.

All questions
What is the txtme.social app?

The digital home for connections that started offline. A profile with twelve photos, messages, group chats with an expiry, a map of real places and Live Pulse. For iOS and Android. Launch is announced.

What is the txtme.social merch?

T-shirts, tank tops, cropped tops, plus caps and bags. Every piece carries a QR code that leads to your personal profile in the app. Someone you meet scans it, and you're connected. The shirt is the gateway, not the product.

Which countries are included in shipping?

Across Europe and internationally through our shipping partner. Every parcel ships insured, and shipping is included in the price. The exact country list and delivery times go on the shipping page as soon as they're fixed.

How can I pay for my merch?

Through Mollie in Amsterdam: Wero, iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Bancomat Pay or direct bank transfer. You enter your payment details at Mollie, not with us. All prices include VAT.

All questions
What is the txtme.social app?

The digital home for connections that started offline. A profile with twelve photos, messages, group chats with an expiry, a map of real places and Live Pulse. For iOS and Android. Launch is announced.

What is the txtme.social merch?

T-shirts, tank tops, cropped tops, plus caps and bags. Every piece carries a QR code that leads to your personal profile in the app. Someone you meet scans it, and you're connected. The shirt is the gateway, not the product.

Which countries are included in shipping?

Across Europe and internationally through our shipping partner. Every parcel ships insured, and shipping is included in the price. The exact country list and delivery times go on the shipping page as soon as they're fixed.

How can I pay for my merch?

Through Mollie in Amsterdam: Wero, iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Bancomat Pay or direct bank transfer. You enter your payment details at Mollie, not with us. All prices include VAT.

Questions? Answers.

All questions
What is the txtme.social app?

The digital home for connections that started offline. A profile with twelve photos, messages, group chats with an expiry, a map of real places and Live Pulse. For iOS and Android. Launch is announced.

What is the txtme.social merch?

T-shirts, tank tops, cropped tops, plus caps and bags. Every piece carries a QR code that leads to your personal profile in the app. Someone you meet scans it, and you're connected. The shirt is the gateway, not the product.

Which countries are included in shipping?

Across Europe and internationally through our shipping partner. Every parcel ships insured, and shipping is included in the price. The exact country list and delivery times go on the shipping page as soon as they're fixed.

How can I pay for my merch?

Through Mollie in Amsterdam: Wero, iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Bancomat Pay or direct bank transfer. You enter your payment details at Mollie, not with us. All prices include VAT.

All questions
What is the txtme.social app?

The digital home for connections that started offline. A profile with twelve photos, messages, group chats with an expiry, a map of real places and Live Pulse. For iOS and Android. Launch is announced.

What is the txtme.social merch?

T-shirts, tank tops, cropped tops, plus caps and bags. Every piece carries a QR code that leads to your personal profile in the app. Someone you meet scans it, and you're connected. The shirt is the gateway, not the product.

Which countries are included in shipping?

Across Europe and internationally through our shipping partner. Every parcel ships insured, and shipping is included in the price. The exact country list and delivery times go on the shipping page as soon as they're fixed.

How can I pay for my merch?

Through Mollie in Amsterdam: Wero, iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Bancomat Pay or direct bank transfer. You enter your payment details at Mollie, not with us. All prices include VAT.

All questions
What is the txtme.social app?

The digital home for connections that started offline. A profile with twelve photos, messages, group chats with an expiry, a map of real places and Live Pulse. For iOS and Android. Launch is announced.

What is the txtme.social merch?

T-shirts, tank tops, cropped tops, plus caps and bags. Every piece carries a QR code that leads to your personal profile in the app. Someone you meet scans it, and you're connected. The shirt is the gateway, not the product.

Which countries are included in shipping?

Across Europe and internationally through our shipping partner. Every parcel ships insured, and shipping is included in the price. The exact country list and delivery times go on the shipping page as soon as they're fixed.

How can I pay for my merch?

Through Mollie in Amsterdam: Wero, iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Bancomat Pay or direct bank transfer. You enter your payment details at Mollie, not with us. All prices include VAT.

Shipping

Insured. Included.

We ship across Europe and internationally through our shipping partner. Every parcel goes out insured, because we value safety and trust.

Shipping is included in the price. All prices include VAT.

Payment

Eight ways. One provider.

All payments run through Mollie in Amsterdam. You enter your payment details there, never with us. We get a yes or a no.

txtme.social

Who or what is txtme.social?

A European social media app, built in Amsterdam. It starts where the others stop: in real life. You're only connected to people you've actually met. No algorithm, no ads, no data selling.

What is the txtme.social app?

The digital home for connections that started offline. A profile with twelve photos, messages, group chats with an expiry, a map of real places and Live Pulse. For iOS and Android. Launch is announced.

What does txtme.social stand for?

Offline over online. Real over fake. Your data stays yours. We're not against tech. We're against manipulation, performance and fake connection.

Trust

Does txtme.social speak for communities?

No. Communities in the app belong to the people who start them. We provide the room, not the opinion. What's said there is said by the members, not by us.

Does txtme.social impose any censorship?

We remove what breaks our Community Guidelines or the law: violence, hate, harassment, illegal content. Opinions we don't like are not on that list. A person decides, not a machine, and you can appeal.

Does txtme.social have any AI features?

No. No AI features, no AI moderation, and your data doesn't train any model. People talk to people. That's the whole point.

Does txtme.social have any algorithms?

No recommendation algorithm. Your feed shows what your connections share, in the order it happened. Twelve stories a day, then it ends. Nobody decides for you what you should see.

Does txtme.social sell my data anonymously?

No. Not anonymised, not aggregated, not to ad partners. There are no ads, so there's nobody to buy your data. It's stored in Europe.

What is the txtme.social “memories” vault?

Posts disappear after 45 days. What matters to you goes into your vault before that. It stays there, for you, not for the feed. Memories, not an archive.

Merch and orders

What is the txtme.social merch?

T-shirts, tank tops, cropped tops, plus caps and bags. Every piece carries a QR code that leads to your personal profile in the app. Someone you meet scans it, and you're connected. The shirt is the gateway, not the product.

Which countries are included in shipping?

Across Europe and internationally through our shipping partner. Every parcel ships insured, and shipping is included in the price. The exact country list and delivery times go on the shipping page as soon as they're fixed.

How can I pay for my merch?

Through Mollie in Amsterdam: Wero, iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, Bancomat Pay or direct bank transfer. You enter your payment details at Mollie, not with us. All prices include VAT.

"""Sprache der Server-Meldungen · Backstage txtme.social.

Die Oberfläche ist Englisch (Auftrag Regel 3), Deutsch per Knopf «DE». Der Server schreibt seine Meldungen deutsch;
diese Datei setzt sie für die englische Oberfläche um, bevor die Antwort rausgeht. Gesteuert über den Kopf
«X-Backstage-Sprache: de» (sonst Englisch). Übersetzt werden nur Meldungs-Felder (titel, text, fehler, hinweis …),
nie Inhalte der Website. Neue Meldung im Server → hier eine Zeile dazu (Muster vor allgemeinen Mustern)."""
import re

# Schlüssel der Angaben und Bereiche, wie sie in Meldungen stehen («Versand: returnDays»)
SCHLUESSEL = {
    'returnDays': 'return period', 'handlingDays': 'handling time', 'cost': 'shipping cost', 'freeFrom': 'free shipping from', 'insured': 'insured',
    'regions': 'countries and delivery times', 'band': 'notice bar', 'de': 'German', 'entwurf': 'draft note',
    'legalName': 'legal name', 'legalFormPending': 'legal form', 'street': 'street', 'postal': 'postcode', 'city': 'city', 'country': 'country',
    'email': 'e-mail general', 'marketingEmail': 'e-mail marketing', 'supportEmail': 'e-mail support', 'salesEmail': 'e-mail business', 'safetyEmail': 'e-mail safety',
    'privacyEmail': 'e-mail privacy', 'pressEmail': 'e-mail press', 'securityEmail': 'e-mail security', 'kvk': 'KvK number', 'vat': 'VAT ID',
    'representative': 'representative', 'phone': 'phone', 'tagline': 'tagline', 'description': 'description', 'terms': 'terms', 'privacy': 'privacy policy',
}
SCHLUESSEL_DE = {
    'legalName': 'Firmenname', 'legalFormPending': 'Rechtsform', 'street': 'Strasse', 'postal': 'PLZ', 'city': 'Ort', 'country': 'Land', 'email': 'E-Mail allgemein',
    'marketingEmail': 'E-Mail Marketing', 'supportEmail': 'E-Mail Support', 'salesEmail': 'E-Mail Business', 'safetyEmail': 'E-Mail Sicherheit', 'privacyEmail': 'E-Mail Datenschutz',
    'pressEmail': 'E-Mail Presse', 'securityEmail': 'E-Mail Security', 'kvk': 'KvK-Nummer', 'vat': 'USt-IdNr.', 'representative': 'Vertreten durch', 'phone': 'Telefon',
}
TEIL = {
    'Produkte': 'Products', 'Neue Produkte': 'New products', 'Reihenfolge': 'Order', 'Kategorien': 'Categories', 'Farben': 'Colours', 'Angaben': 'Details',
    'Versand': 'Shipping', 'Zahlarten': 'Payment methods', 'Fragen': 'Questions', 'Presse': 'Press', 'Rechtliches': 'Legal', 'Google & Teilen': 'Google & sharing',
    'Hinweis': 'Draft note', 'Hinweis-Leiste': 'Notice bar', 'Ausgeblendet': 'Hidden', 'Texte': 'Texts', 'Bilder': 'Images', 'Bildbeschreibungen': 'Image descriptions', 'Sprachen': 'Languages',
}
WEG = {'aendern': 'change', 'veroeffentlichen': 'publish', 'zurueckholen': 'bring back', 'zuruecknehmen': 'take back', 'verwerfen': 'discard', 'rueckgaengig': 'undo', 'bild': 'upload an image', 'reparieren': 'repair', 'zugang': 'access', 'antwort': 'reply'}
ROLLE = {'admin': 'admin', 'redaktion': 'editor', 'lesen': 'viewer'}


def _teil(t):
    return TEIL.get(t, t)


def _schl(k):
    return SCHLUESSEL.get(k, k)


def _schl_de(k):
    for a, b in SCHLUESSEL_DE.items():
        if b == k:
            return SCHLUESSEL.get(a, k)
    return k


FELD_EN = {'Text': 'The text', 'Notiz': 'The note', 'Bildbeschreibung': 'The image description', 'Google-Text': 'The Google text', 'Text der Hinweis-Leiste': 'The text of the notice bar',
           'Link der Hinweis-Leiste': 'The link of the notice bar', 'Linktext der Hinweis-Leiste': 'The link text of the notice bar', 'Datum': 'The date', 'Bearbeitung': 'The handling time',
           'Versandkosten': 'Shipping cost', 'Versandkostenfrei ab': 'Free shipping from', 'Rückgabefrist': 'Return period', 'Preis': 'The price', 'Länder und Laufzeiten': 'Countries and delivery times',

def _feld_en(f):
    if f in FELD_EN:
        return FELD_EN[f]
    for a, b in SCHLUESSEL_DE.items():
        if b == f:
            return SCHLUESSEL.get(a, f)[:1].upper() + SCHLUESSEL.get(a, f)[1:]
    return f


def _name_en(f):
    """Name eines Feldes in Listen («Versand: Bearbeitung» → «Shipping: Handling time»)."""
    n = _feld_en(f) if (f in FELD_EN or f in SCHLUESSEL_DE.values()) else _schl(f)
    return n[4:5].upper() + n[5:] if n.startswith('The ') else n


def _rolle(r):
    return ROLLE.get(r, r)


def _mal(n, ein, viele):
    return f'{n} {ein if str(n) == "1" else viele}'

def _pruef(s):
    for re_, f in PRUEF:
        m = re_.match(s)
        if m:
            return f(m)
    return s


def en_text(s):
    """Eine Meldung ins Englische; Unbekanntes bleibt, wie es ist."""
    if not isinstance(s, str) or not s:
        return s
    if s in GLEICH:
        return GLEICH[s]
    for re_, f in MUSTER:
        m = re_.match(s)
        if m:
            return f(m)
    if ' · ' in s:   # zusammengesetzte Quittung «Versand: returnDays · Versand: handlingDays»
        teile = s.split(' · ')
        neu = [en_text(t) for t in teile]
        if neu != teile:
            return ' · '.join(neu)
    return s


FELDER = {'titel', 'text', 'fehler', 'hinweis', 'hinweise', 't', 'schritt', 'geaendert', 'meldung', 'aussen', 'was', 'wo'}
OHNE = {'inventar', 'daten', 'katalog', 'bilder', 'vergleich', 'angaben', 'code'}


def en(d, weg=''):
    """Antwort d für die englische Oberfläche. Nur Meldungs-Felder, keine Inhalte (weg in OHNE bleibt unberührt)."""
    if weg in OHNE:
        return d

    def gehe(x, feld=''):
        if isinstance(x, dict):
            return {k: gehe(v, k) for k, v in x.items()}
        if isinstance(x, list):
            return [gehe(v, feld) for v in x]
        if isinstance(x, str) and feld in FELDER:
            return en_text(x)
        return x
    return gehe(d)

"""Online-Fassung von Backstage: der echte Server (backstage.py) läuft im Browser (Pyodide), ohne Netz.

Jede Anfrage der Oberfläche und jede Website-Seite in einem Rahmen geht an anfrage(): dort bekommt der unveränderte Handler
von backstage.py eine nachgebaute HTTP-Anfrage und schreibt seine Antwort in einen Puffer. Die Daten (inhalt/) liegen im
Speicher des Browsers; sichern() gibt sie als ein Paket für localStorage zurück, laden() legt sie beim Öffnen zurück.
Was sich aus den Daten neu rechnen lässt (veröffentlichte Seiten live/, Probe _bau/, Seiten-Kopien im Verlauf), wird
nicht gesichert, sondern beim Laden aus stand.json neu gesetzt."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import sys
import threading
from email.message import Message

WURZEL = '/app'
sys.argv = ['backstage.py']
os.environ['TXTME_OUT'] = WURZEL + '/out'
sys.path.insert(0, WURZEL + '/_backstage')


# Pyodide kennt keine Threads: «Veröffentlichen» läuft dann gleich in der Anfrage, die Oberfläche fragt danach den fertigen Stand ab.
def _start(self):
    self._target(*self._args, **self._kwargs)


threading.Thread.start = _start

import backstage as B  # noqa: E402
import inhalt as I  # noqa: E402

PORT = B.PORT
UEBERSPRINGEN = ('live', '_bau')


class _Anfrage(B.Handler):
    def __init__(self, methode, pfad, kopf, rumpf):
        self.command, self.path, self.request_version = methode, pfad, 'HTTP/1.1'
        self.requestline = f'{methode} {pfad} HTTP/1.1'
        self.headers = Message()
        for k, v in kopf.items():
            self.headers[k] = v
        self.rfile, self.wfile = io.BytesIO(rumpf), io.BytesIO()
        self.client_address = ('127.0.0.1', 0)
        self.close_connection = False


def anfrage(methode, pfad, kopf_json, rumpf):
    """→ JSON {status, kopf: [[name, wert]], rumpf: base64}."""
    kopf = json.loads(kopf_json or '{}')
    kopf.setdefault('Host', f'127.0.0.1:{PORT}')
    if methode == 'POST':
        kopf.setdefault('Origin', f'http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}')
    roh = rumpf.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(rumpf, str) else bytes(rumpf or b'')
    if roh:
        kopf['Content-Length'] = str(len(roh))
    a = _Anfrage(methode, pfad, kopf, roh)
    (a.do_POST if methode == 'POST' else a.do_GET)()
    a.wfile.flush()
    antwort = a.wfile.getvalue()
    kopfteil, _, inhalt = antwort.partition(b'\r\n\r\n')
    zeilen = kopfteil.decode('latin-1').split('\r\n')
    status = int(zeilen[0].split(' ')[1])
    paare = [z.split(': ', 1) for z in zeilen[1:] if ': ' in z]
    return json.dumps({'status': status, 'kopf': paare, 'rumpf': base64.b64encode(inhalt).decode('ascii')})


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ Sichern und Laden (localStorage)
def _dateien(basis, praefix):
    aus = {}
    if not os.path.isdir(basis):
        return aus
    for d, dirs, files in os.walk(basis):
        rel_d = os.path.relpath(d, basis)
        if rel_d == '.':
            dirs[:] = [x for x in dirs if x not in UEBERSPRINGEN]
        dirs[:] = [x for x in dirs if not x.endswith('-dateien')]
        for f in files:
            p = os.path.join(d, f)
            rel = os.path.relpath(p, basis)
            with open(p, 'rb') as fh:
                aus[praefix + rel] = base64.b64encode(fh.read()).decode('ascii')
    return aus


def sichern():
    paket = _dateien(B.DATEN, 'inhalt/')
    paket.update(_dateien(B.UPLOADS, 'uploads/'))
    return json.dumps(paket)


def laden(paket_json):
    try:
        paket = json.loads(paket_json or '{}')
    except ValueError:
        paket = {}
    for rel, b64 in paket.items():
        art, _, rest = rel.partition('/')
        basis = {'inhalt': B.DATEN, 'uploads': B.UPLOADS}.get(art)
        if not basis or '..' in rest:
            continue
        p = os.path.join(basis, rest)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
        with open(p, 'wb') as fh:
            fh.write(base64.b64decode(b64))
    live_setzen()
    return len(paket)


def live_setzen():
    """Die veröffentlichten Seiten aus stand.json neu setzen (so wie _veroeffentlichen sie schreibt)."""
    if not os.path.exists(B.F_STAND):
        return 0
    c = B.ohne_privat(B.stand())
    cd = I.code()
    n = 0
    for k, pfad, datei in I.seiten_liste():
        ziel = os.path.join(B.LIVE, k) if k else B.LIVE
        os.makedirs(ziel, exist_ok=True)
        with open(os.path.join(ziel, 'index.html'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(I.seite_mit(k, c, 'html', 'live', cd))
        n += 1
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(datei), 'index.txt')):
            with open(os.path.join(ziel, 'index.txt'), 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                f.write(I.seite_mit(k, c, 'txt', 'live', cd))
    return n


def medien(medien_json):
    """Die Bilder der Website liegen nicht in Python, nur ihre Namen (leere Dateien): Grösse und Masse kommen aus dem Bau."""
    m = json.loads(medien_json)
    groesse = os.path.getsize
    os.path.getsize = lambda p: m[p][0] if isinstance(p, str) and p in m else groesse(p)
    try:
        from PIL import Image
    except ImportError:
        return

    class _Mass:
        def __init__(self, s):
            self.size = tuple(s)

        def __enter__(self):
            return self

        def __exit__(self, *a):
            return False

    oeffnen = Image.open
    Image.open = lambda fp, *a, **k: _Mass(m[fp][1:3]) if isinstance(fp, str) and fp in m else oeffnen(fp, *a, **k)


def zuruecksetzen():
    import shutil
    for basis in (B.DATEN, B.UPLOADS):
        shutil.rmtree(basis, ignore_errors=True)
        os.makedirs(basis, exist_ok=True)
    B.LAUF.update(laeuft=False, schritt='', schritte=[], fertig=None, fehler='')
    return True
